title: Correct per-artifact runtime-kit verification and native smokes
body:
Fresh audit found that the current matrix merges static/shared symbol evidence, so one artifact can mask missing exports in the other, and applies static-style verification to shared loader/TLS imports. Existing AOT evidence resolves an archive without linking and executing it. The last runner-native attempt failed all three hosts, while later Windows/macOS fixes have not reached native jobs because the Rust gate skips them. The fix must separate static/shared reports and policies, add real AOT execution plus equivalent JIT/REPL/public-run smokes, and retain exact metadata/hash/import-library checks.

**Linear:** [CYB-182](https://linear.app/cybernomad-it/issue/CYB-182/v04-correct-per-artifact-runtime-kit-verification-and-native-smokes)

subtasks.text: Separate static/shared provenance reports and verifier policies
Run hermetic verifier and CLI RED/GREEN tests
Add real profile-parametric AOT link/execute and run/REPL smokes
Verify Linux x86-64 debug/release static/shared kits
Verify macOS arm64 debug/release static/shared kits
Verify Windows x86-64 debug/release static/shared kits
